This '''rogue assassin droid''' was one of the early models of [[Unidentified Imperial assassin droid|Imperial assassin droid]] and was re-programmed by [[Maliiki]], a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]], wishing to obtain an information crystal. He was attacked by a later model [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] at a salvage yard and retreated inside; the later models of assassin droids were built with more brawn than brains, so chances of defection were lowered. Maliiki was also attacked and required rescuing.
